hooks.command: python3 -c "import sys,json,re; d=json.load(sys.stdin); c=d.get('tool_input',{}).get('command',''); CMDPOS=r'(?m)(?:^|[;&|]\s*|\$\(\s*)'; m=(re.search(CMDPOS+r'sed\s+-n\b[^\n]*p\b',c) and 'Use the Read tool (offset/limit) instead of sed -n — sed views have errored in this harness.') or (re.search(CMDPOS+r'pkill\s+-f\b',c) and 'pkill -f matches this shell itself (past self-kills, exit 144). Use pgrep -f + filter out \$\$ or track PIDs.'); print(json.dumps({'hookSpecificOutput':{'hookEventName':'PreToolUse','permissionDecision':'deny','permissionDecisionReason':m}}) if m else '')" 2>/dev/null || true

python3 -c "import sys,json,subprocess; d=json.load(sys.stdin); f=d.get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path','') or d.get('tool_response',{}).get('filePath',''); f.endswith('.py') and subprocess.run(['ruff','check',f])" || true

python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); f=d.get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path','') or d.get('tool_response',{}).get('filePath',''); hit=f.endswith('.py') and ('/darq_xray/stages/' in f or '/darq_xray/gui/' in f); msg='Reminder: you edited pipeline code ('+f+'). If a stage parameter, behaviour, input/output, or a viewer changed, update docs/Usage.md and docs/Codebase.md in this SAME change (see CLAUDE.md).'; print(json.dumps({'hookSpecificOutput':{'hookEventName':'PostToolUse','additionalContext':msg}}) if hit else '')" 2>/dev/null || true
